feasibility_basis.observed_failure: MASSIVE en-US/audio_volume_other has 18 train rows; v1 required 20 per locale-intent cell.
feasibility_basis.permitted_change: Sampling cardinality only: 20 -> 15 examples per locale-intent cell per split.

question: Does language-centroid removal suppress real multilingual encoder language leakage while preserving intent signal, and does it do so more specifically than generic controls?
claim_boundary: Real frozen-encoder representation diagnostic only. No linguistic-relativity, cognition, translation-quality, universal-representation, or fine-tuned-model claim.

dataset.selection: For each locale and intent, rank examples by SHA-256(seed || id); select the first 15 fit examples and first 15 evaluation examples. Fail closed if any locale-intent cell has fewer than 15 examples in either split.

primary_probe: nearest-centroid Euclidean classifier fit only on the fit split

transforms.language_centering: subtract each locale's fit-split embedding centroid from fit and evaluation embeddings of that locale
transforms.random_group_centering: assign records to 3 deterministic SHA-256 groups per seed and subtract fit centroids for those pseudo-groups
transforms.random_subspace: remove projection onto 2 deterministic Gaussian orthonormal directions per seed

metrics.specificity_margin: language_centering_normalized_reduction - max(global_centering, random_group_centering, random_subspace normalized reductions)

predeclared_falsifiers: Specificity margin <= 0, meaning a generic control matches or beats language centering.
The sign of the parent effect reverses.
The data/model revisions cannot be materialized exactly or provenance hashes are missing.
authorization_scope: Execute exactly this v2 cheap frozen gate. Any additional encoder, locale, dataset, threshold, transform, probe, sampling-cardinality change, or tuned successor requires a new versioned manifest before outcome access.
